implementation: FactsPhase distinguishes Ordinary, Header(group) and Body(header). Recursive collection accepts all declaration headers before executing initializers and bodies; native private memo binds each accepted header to its exact group, target, BindingId and issuance order.

Body reuses accepted header Entity IDs and exports. Header references and resolution updates are rejected. Reissuing an existing Entity ID is rejected, while a distinct authorized ID is not treated as the same declaration merely because its name or source range matches.

Owned and borrowed Facts requests share phase validation. The same callback receives actual first-receiver CBOR requests and replies with native-equivalent facts, stages, resolution history and reports, using the original operation Budget and SourceAdmission.

ForeignClosure captures guest syntax and the selected owner environment with its original owner origin/source/map closure. Owner and guest local ID spaces remain separate; no owner AST or ambient source lookup is required by the receiving codec.
R046 separates symbolic EnvironmentNamespaceRef(schema,name) from numeric facts NamespaceRef, fixing real nonempty environment digest and codec failures.
R047 extracts all actual typed nested WireError stop causes while preserving ordinary semantic errors. No stopped-Budget fallback replaces unrelated semantic errors.

independent_review.recursive: Nine original source inputs and four additional boundary cases check header-before-body order, mutual references, mixed static/custom plans, sequential contrast, repeated plans, same-name distinct IDs, Foreign roots, Unicode ranges, denied header references, reused IDs and cancellation. Missing owner sources, cross-arena substitutions, false digests and schema/root mismatch are rejected. Eight managed syntax tests passed natively and under WASI.
